scope: Studio only; no UE migration, build or asset import

request.damage: Only resolved, positive, non-DOT hits deplete the stun bar; shield absorption does not prevent depletion.
request.recovery: After one second without such a hit, restore the missing portion linearly within three seconds. A new hit depletes it and restarts the delay.
request.dot: DOT and zero damage neither deplete the bar nor restart the recovery delay.
request.display: The main HUD displays remaining durability over capacity and starts full.
request.empty: Keep the existing half-second stun and attack interruption. An empty bar cannot repeatedly stun; once partially restored, another depletion can stun again.

causes: The cleared-dungeon branch skipped Battle.step, freezing both the character stun countdown and layer recovery while collecting loot.
The main HUD had been bound to accumulated damage divided by maximum life instead of remaining layer durability.

fix.combatAfterClear: Advance stun countdown and layer recovery only; do not restart attacks, DOT, life/shield/mana recovery or reward settlement.
fix.engine: Rule VM and Character damage resolver unchanged
fix.headOverlay: Existing UICreator yellow accumulated-damage overlay retained separately from the main remaining-durability bar.

dungeon.unrelatedFailure: fixed-equipment.test.mjs:44 expects every spawned monster to have the chosen common rarity, including the mandatory boss; the case does not enable stunCrust.
